headline.purpose: The one news headline; Archivo at font-stretch 70%.

quote.purpose: Large pane values; Martian Mono at font-stretch 87.5%.

motion.name: cell-fade
motion.purpose: Quote-board cell tint on metric switch.

motion.name: tape
motion.purpose: Ticker marquee; paused on hover/focus and under reduced motion.

components.name: Function Key
components.description: Numbered section key in the command bar; amber when its section is in view.
components.css: .ds-keys { display: flex; background: #000; font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-stretch: 87.5%; font-size: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #474747; } .ds-keys a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 12px; color: #a3a3a3; text-decoration: none; border-right: 1px solid #2b2b2b; transition: color 160ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-keys a:hover { color: #ececec; background: #141414; } .ds-keys a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffa028; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-keys a[aria-current='true'] { color: #ffa028; background: #1d1205; } .ds-keys kbd { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; background: #ffa028; color: #1a0f00; font-weight: 700; font-family: inherit; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Radio group for suite and metric; selected segment filled amber.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #474747; } .ds-seg button { font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-stretch: 87.5%; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: #000; color: #a3a3a3; border: 0; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid #474747; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #ececec; background: #141414; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffa028; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-seg button[aria-checked='true'] { background: #ffa028; color: #1a0f00; }

components.name: Family Pane Quote
components.description: One metric quote inside a family pane; the leading value across families is amber.
components.css: .ds-quote { background: #0b0b0b; padding: 10px 14px; margin: 0; border: 1px solid #2b2b2b; } .ds-quote dt { font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-stretch: 87.5%; font-size: 11px; color: #7a7a7a; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-quote dd { margin: 2px 0 0; font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-stretch: 87.5%; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; color: #ececec; } .ds-quote dd.lead { color: #ffa028; }

components.name: Claim Stamp
components.description: Status of an earlier claim: held, revised or overturned.
components.html: HELD REVISED OVERTURNED
components.css: .ds-stamp { font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-stretch: 87.5%; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 3px 7px; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-stamp.held { color: #4aa8ff; } .ds-stamp.revised { color: #ffa028; } .ds-stamp.over { color: #000; background: #ff5a4e; border-color: #ff5a4e; }

components.name: Quote Board Cell
components.description: Score relative to the baseline; tint by log-ratio, number always printed, best outlined.
components.html: 0.6390.6371.020
components.css: .ds-board { border-collapse: collapse; font-family: 'Martian Mono', monospace; font-stretch: 87.5%; font-size: 12px; background: #0b0b0b; } .ds-board td { padding: 7px 10px; text-align: right; color: #ececec; background: var(--cell, transparent); border-bottom: 1px solid #1b1b1b; } .ds-board td.best { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #ffa028; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: Model families quoted like securities: a pane per family, a quote grid per series, findings on a ticker, corrections stamped. Terminal grammar for data and navigation; proportional Archivo for prose.
keyCharacteristics: Blue/red quote ink with printed numbers
Martian Mono at 87.5% width for data

rules.name: Amber Is Chrome
rules.body: Amber marks commands, selection and the leading value, never decoration.

rules.name: Numbers Always Printed
rules.body: Colour never carries a value alone.

rules.name: Mono Means Data
rules.body: Martian Mono for data, commands and labels; prose stays in Archivo.

dos: Keep tables in their own scroll region
donts: No rounded corners, shadows, gradients or glass
No family colour meaning better or worse
